```yaml
# NON-COMPUTE gate (annotation-hygiene two-branch decision). Items (2)/(3)/(4) take the
# N/A-with-reason form. The real PASS criterion is in (1) operator + the verdict rubric.

# (1) operator — the annotation-consistency predicate
operator:
  type: "set"
  form: >
    PASS iff (after the chosen resolution is applied)
      [ Resolution (a): each of the four S96-GEOM-TAUINF-PETROV companion comment rows'
        Petrov-type/window prose is consistent with the canonical value-field
        (dyn_window=tau<=6, dynamic_resolvable=I) ]
      OR
      [ Resolution (b): the canonical PASS line is followed by an explicit
        'value-field governs' note naming the value-field window as authoritative and the
        companion boilerplate as retained-historical ]
      AND the canonical `value=`/`audit_sha256`/`content_sha256` lines are UNCHANGED
          byte-for-byte (verdict permanence preserved)
      AND the resolution chosen is honestly named in the verdict line + WP §W6-2.

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary — non-numerical gate
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "N/A — annotation-consistency two-branch predicate; no scalar threshold"
  direction: "="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically — non-numerical gate
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: false
  proof_ref: "null — predicate is comment/value-field consistency, not an analytic boundary"

# (4) reachable_rationals — non-numerical gate
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "N/A — non-numerical (two-branch adjudication) gate"

# (5) machinery_pin_map — every free parameter pinned
machinery_pin_map:
  # The canonical line whose value-field is authoritative (pinned by SUPERSESSION-CHAIN
  # IDENTITY, not brittle absolute line number — the file has duplicate emission blocks and
  # the line numbers in the S96 CF text (123/128/131/134) have drifted; the canonical line is
  # the LATEST NON-SUPERSEDED PASS line per gate-verdicts.md §"Option A" reading discipline):
  canonical_line_identity: "S96-GEOM-TAUINF-PETROV PASS line with audit_sha256=8f49af075339ccac65f14478b944d57720033de4892e27ed0d785a739c761074 (latest non-superseded; supersedes=ec80321557379a00…); value-field reads dyn_window=tau<=6(6/12), dynamic_resolvable=I, S84_continuation=(static=True,dynamic=True)"
  authoritative_value_window: "dyn_window=tau<=6(6/12)"   # the window the companion comment must match (resolution a) or be governed-by (resolution b)
  authoritative_asymptotic_dynamic_type: "dynamic_resolvable=I"  # second point of conflict: the boilerplate says 'Type G PERSIST to tau->inf'; the canonical value-field says asymptotic dynamic resolves to Type-I below float64
  stale_companion_rows: "the four `# audit_sha256_short=… # S96-GEOM-TAUINF-PETROV dual-SHA companion row; …` rows carrying 'static Type D / dynamic Type G PERSIST to tau->inf' (one per Option-A re-emission: f260302b…, 4789decf…, ec803215…, 8f49af07…)"
  pin_by: "supersession-chain identity + grep on the audit_sha256, NOT absolute line number"
  resolution_set: "{(a) companion-text touch-up to match value-field window; (b) explicit value-field-governs note appended under the canonical line}"
  verdict_permanence_constraint: "the canonical value=/audit_sha256/content_sha256 lines and the schema-v2 3-tuple rows are NEVER edited; only the companion COMMENT prose (resolution a) or an APPENDED note (resolution b) is touched"
  orchestrator_direct: "TRUE — candidate for in-session orchestrator-direct resolution without a dispatched executor, per mechanical-closure-discipline.md; if so resolved, the honesty discipline (verdict line names the resolution + WP §W6-2 discloses it) is MANDATORY"
  N_eval: "N/A — no numerical evaluation"
  L_max: "N/A — no spectral truncation (the underlying NP-CMPP analysis is closed-form Jensen metric; this gate does not re-run it)"
  scan_range: "N/A — no scan"
  step_size: "N/A — no scan"
  tolerance: "N/A — annotation-consistency predicate, no numerical tolerance"
  scheme: "annotation-hygiene-companion-comment-consistency"
  convention: "value-field-governs (verdict permanence)"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "N/A — no linear algebra (text consistency + dual-SHA only)"

# (6) audit_discriminators — METHODOLOGY-class dual-SHA closure form
audit_discriminators:
  # content_sha256 over the verdict-file companion-comment DIFF (resolution a) OR the
  #   appended-note line (resolution b) — the F-image of the numerical PASS-predicate;
  # audit_sha256 over the input-pin map (the canonical-line identity + the four stale
  #   companion-row identities + the chosen resolution).
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "verdict_file_pin", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]
  methodology_class_note: >
    Annotation-hygiene is the verdict-file analog of a rule-file diff. audit_sha256 pins the
    input-pin map (which companion rows, which canonical line, which resolution); content_sha256
    pins the script bytes. The resolution edit/append is applied by the orchestrator (or the
    executor) BEFORE this verification script computes the dual-SHA, so the SHA pins the
    post-resolution verdict-file state. The canonical PASS line's OWN audit_sha256
    (8f49af07…) is UNCHANGED — this gate's dual-SHA is a SEPARATE S97 closure documenting the
    annotation-hygiene decision, not a re-emission of the S96 Petrov gate.

# (7) substitution_chain — NOT required (no sign/direction/threshold claim)
substitution_chain:
  required: false
  content: >
    N/A — this gate makes no sign/direction/threshold claim. It is a two-branch annotation-
    hygiene adjudication: the "conflict" is a documented PROSE-vs-value-field inconsistency
    (the companion boilerplate "dynamic Type G PERSIST to tau->inf" vs the canonical value-field
    "dyn_window=tau<=6(6/12)" + "dynamic_resolvable=I"), already disclosed in W5 WP §W5-3
    methodology §6. No numerical direction is read off; the decision is categorical (resolution
    a vs b), both acceptable.

# (8) input_files — every file read, with SHA pin
input_files:
  verdict_file:
    path: "computations/session-96/s96_gate_verdicts.txt"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"          # the S96 verdict file carrying the canonical Petrov PASS line + the four stale companion rows; SHA pinned at execution. NOTE: this gate WRITES its own verdict line to the S97 verdict file (computations/session-97/s97_gate_verdicts.txt), and (under resolution a/b) edits/appends a COMMENT in the S96 verdict file — the S96 canonical value lines are untouched.
  w5_workingpaper:
    path: "sessions/archive/session-96/session-96-w5-workingpaper.md"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"          # §W5-3 methodology §6 regime-artifact disclosure (the basis for resolution b's governs-note pointer)

# ---- Output artifacts (closure-verification checklist) ----
output_artifacts:
  script:
    path: "computations/session-97/s97_w6_petrov_annotation.py"
    artifact_kind: "script"
    must_contain:
      - "from canonical_constants import"
      - "append_verdict"
  data:
    path: "computations/session-97/s97_w6_petrov_annotation.npz"
    artifact_kind: "data"
    optional: true                           # annotation-hygiene has no natural data array; a small npz recording {resolution_chosen, canonical_line_audit_sha, companion_rows_touched} MAY be emitted. optional:true so a missing npz is not a stub-flag.
  plot:
    path: "computations/session-97/s97_w6_petrov_annotation.png"
    artifact_kind: "plot"
    optional: true                           # no numerical plot for an annotation decision. optional:true.
  verdict_line:
    path: "computations/session-97/s97_gate_verdicts.txt"
    artifact_kind: "verdict_line"
    must_contain: "^S97-W6-2-PETROV-ANNOTATION:.* audit_sha256=[a-f0-9]{64}"
    companion_row_required: true
    schema_v2_3tuple_required: false         # no [SIGN] trigger
  wp_section:
    path: "sessions/archive/session-97/session-97-w6-workingpaper.md"
    artifact_kind: "wp_section"
    section_anchor: "### §W6-2. S97-W6-2-PETROV-ANNOTATION"
    must_contain:
      - "\\*\\*Status\\*\\*:.*COMPLETED"
      - "\\*\\*Verdict\\*\\*:.*(PASS|FAIL|INFO)"
      - "\\*\\*Output Artifacts\\*\\*"
      - "\\*\\*MCP Pre-Compute Audit\\*\\*"
      - "value-field governs"                # both resolutions hinge on the value-field being authoritative; the WP must state it
      - "verdict permanence"                 # the WP must record that the canonical lines were NOT touched

# ---- Verdict rubric (3 fields) ----
PASS_meaning: >
  The chosen resolution is applied and leaves the companion-comment annotation consistent with
  (resolution a) or explicitly governed-by (resolution b) the canonical value-field window
  (dyn_window=tau<=6, dynamic_resolvable=I), with the canonical value=/audit_sha256/content_sha256
  lines UNCHANGED. Solution-space meaning: the gate-finalization annotation drift the S96
  /rclab-investigate consolidator flagged is CLOSED; the verdict file no longer carries a
  companion comment that contradicts its own authoritative value-field.
FAIL_meaning: >
  Neither resolution is cleanly applied — e.g., the companion text is edited to a state STILL
  inconsistent with the value-field (resolution a botched), OR no governs-note is added while the
  boilerplate is left (resolution b not actually applied), OR — the disqualifying case — a
  canonical value=/audit_sha256/content_sha256 line was edited (verdict-permanence violation,
  PROHIBITED_ACTIONS Class-3/4). Solution-space meaning: the hygiene item is unresolved or, worse,
  the audit trail was corrupted.
INFO_meaning: >
  Resolution (b) is chosen and the gate records that the comment boilerplate is retained-historical
  with a value-field-governs note — a deliberate "leave-as-is + annotate" outcome. INFO is the
  honest token for resolution (b) (the comment is NOT made literally consistent; it is explicitly
  flagged as historical), distinct from resolution (a)'s PASS (comment made literally consistent).
  Both are acceptable per the gate definition; the verdict token records WHICH was chosen.

# ---- Effort + framing (2 fields) ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/_shared/s97_w6_petrov_annotation.py"
  estimated_time: "< 0.1 wave (a mechanical companion-comment touch-up or a one-line governs-note at session-close; orchestrator-direct candidate)"

substrate_framing: |
  GEOMETRIC. The underlying observable is the τ→∞ Petrov/CMPP type of the 12D Jensen-deformed
  product metric ds² = −dt² + a(t)²dx₃² + g_ab(τ)dy^a dy^b — a property of the fabric's
  fiber-geometry, derived from the Ψ_ABCD/Weyl-operator block-eigenvalue scaling of the exact
  closed-form Jensen metric (2,−6,4)/8. The substrate IS Type-D static (the contracting SU(2)
  block carries divergent Weyl content → timelike i+; the expanding C2/U(1) blocks carry
  convergent Weyl content → spacelike), censored by COSMIC-CENSORSHIP-49 (barrier τ~0.19 ≪
  τ_NEC~1.38). This gate does NOT re-derive any of that — it reconciles a stale verdict-file
  COMMENT (which still asserts the pre-supersession "dynamic Type G PERSIST to tau->inf" reading)
  with the canonical value-field's corrected window (dynamic resolvable only to τ≤6; asymptotic
  dynamic=Type-I below float64). The substrate physics is unchanged; only the methodology-floor
  annotation is brought into F-consistency with the substrate-IS verdict.
```

(Precedent: the S96 W7-2 `S96-HYG-CANONICAL-PINS` gate is the direct analog — a METHODOLOGY-class canonical-pin provenance gate; 6.1 mirrors it exactly.) **I (gen-physicist, per-wave planner) do NOT edit the allowlist or its ledger — subagent edit is denied; this is an orchestrator action.**
